{{Quote|General Rieekan's forces had successfully attacked the city of Tiems, destroying a power station and liberating several thousand Rebels incarcerated there. The Alliance transports scheduled to take his forces off-planet were delayed by enemy starfighter action ''[&hellip;]''|General Crix Madine|<ref name="RAS2" />}}
'''Tiems''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]]. It was the site of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tiems]], which hosted a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] outpost during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], with an Imperial base being situated in its vicinity. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] force under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] led an attack on the city, in the process liberating several thousand Rebel [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. While waiting for delayed Alliance [[Transport/Legends|transports]] to take them off-planet, Rieekan's force subsequently engaged and prevailed over Imperial [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] in what became known as the [[Battle of Tiems]]. Afterward, the Rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were transported off Tiems.

==Description==
{{Quote|''[&hellip;]'' the Imperials delayed their attack another 12 hours while waiting for the weather to clear up enough to allow them to call on air support from a nearby base.|General Crix Madine|<ref name="RAS2" />}}
Tiems<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30847766|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2010-03-31|quote=Re Tiems, yes, city of Tiems on planet of same name. Thinking is the Rebel Sourcebook had ample opportunity to name a planet but didn't, and 'Battle of Tiems' implies a larger conflict, so Tiems it is. Both admittedly judgment calls, but the Atlas demanded a bunch of those.}}</ref> was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="RAS2" /> located in the [[Tiems system/Legends|Tiems system]], a part of the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The weather on the planet could at times impede the operation of combat aircraft.<ref name="RAS2" />

==History==
{{Main|Battle of Tiems}}
{{Quote|By the time ''[the Imperials]'' launched their attack, the Alliance forces were safely off-planet.|General Crix Madine|<ref name="RAS2" />}}
[[File:Tiems_battle_progression.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The progression of the Battle of Tiems.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained an outpost in Tiems' [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Tiems|same name]]<ref name="CSWE Tiems" /> and incarcerated several thousand members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at the settlement.<ref name="RAS2" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="0 ABY">{{FactFile2014|10|RIE 1-2|General Rieekan}} dates the [[Battle of Tiems]] to between the [[Battle of Nentan]] and the [[Evacuation of Yavin]], with ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dating the latter to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Furthermore, {{DB|character|majorbrenderlin|Derlin, Major Bren}} establishes that [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]] was promoted to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Major/Legends|major]] after the Battle of Nentan, but ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'' depicts Derlin as still being a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. According to ''The New Essential Chronology'', that means that the Battle of Tiems must have taken place in 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]]<ref name="FF10">{{FactFile2014|10|RIE 1-2|General Rieekan}}</ref> Alliance [[General/Legends|general]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] a Rebel force in attacking the city of Tiems, destroying a [[Tiems power station|power station]] there and liberating the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. However, Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] delayed the arrival of Alliance [[Transport/Legends|transports]] that were supposed to take Rieekan's [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] off-planet.<ref name="RAS2" />

Subsequently, in a [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground]] engagement that became known as the [[Battle of Tiems]], an [[Unidentified Imperial general (Tiems)|Imperial general]], striking from battle lines that enclosed the city of Tiems, led an [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] force in a counter-attack on the Rebel force. Rieekan was then forced to defend the designated landing zone area, situated beyond a [[Unidentified town (Tiems)|town]] in Tiems' vicinity, until the arrival of the Rebel transports. During the battle, the Alliance force used mobile defense tactics to destroy two of the four Imperial [[Regiment/Legends|regiments]] and cause the remainder of the attacking force to disorderly retreat to Tiems. Although twenty-four [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later the Imperials were reinforced by a [[Division/Legends|division]] of soldiers, the former waited for another twelve hours for the weather to clear up so that air support could be had in the upcoming attack. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] that offensive was launched, however, the Alliance forces had been transported off-world.<ref name="RAS2" />

Rieekan later illustrated the progression of the Battle of Tiems in a series of diagrams included in an [[After-action report/Legends|After Action Report]]. Those diagrams were subsequently used by General [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] to augment an account of the engagement on Tiems used as an example given during an orientation meeting to new Alliance ground unit [[Commander/Legends|commanders]].<ref name="RAS2" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|The reinforcements, an entire division of native troops, arrived 24 hours later ''[&hellip;]''|General Crix Madine|<ref name="RAS2" />}}
During the Battle of Tiems, the Galactic Empire force was able to summon reinforcements consisting of a division of [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] troops.<ref name="RAS2" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|The Rebels in the forest and behind the river have orders to stand firm; the Rebels in the center gap have orders to fall back when strongly attacked.|General Crix Madine|<ref name="RAS2" />}}
Tiems was the site of a city of the same name, which was situated near two other settlements, including a town. The city of Tiems lay at the intersection of two roads, including [[Tiems Road]], which connected it to the town. Also near Tiems were the [[Gopps Forest]] and a bend of the [[Blue River]] that was crossed by three bridges. A Galactic Empire base was located in the vicinity of Tiems.<ref name="RAS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet on which the city of Tiems was located was first mentioned in [[Paul Murphy]]'s [[1990]] ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', which was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RAS">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Tiems [[Star system/Legends|system]] in grid square R-6,<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Jason Fry]], co-author of that book, later confirmed that "Tiems" was also intended to be the name of the corresponding planet.<ref name="JCF" />
